notes:
SUMMARY:
- Mid-market SaaS (workforce automation) building an agentic product: chat assistant that performs multi-step workflows (search internal KB -> call task-api -> confirm action) for enterprise customers.
- Evaluating Hosted API first (fast onboarding) then Dedicated if SLOs & cost align.

KEY REQUIREMENTS / SUCCESS METRICS:
- Latency SLOs: first-token streaming <= 200-400ms for interactive chat; end-to-end multi-step action (search + tool-call) median < 1.5s target for majority of flows (customer flexible on tail).
- Tool-calling: must support function/tool calling with deterministic retry semantics and clear timeout behavior. Needed: reliable success/failure signals and idempotency keys.
- Streaming/partial outputs: critical for UX (progressive UI). Must support chunked streaming plus tool-call orchestration without broken streams.
- Observability: per-request tracing (token timing), tool-call timing, and error breakdown for SLO dashboards.
- Privacy/compliance: SSO/SAML, audit logging, KMS for keys, and option for EU data residency for some customers.

POC PLAN (agreed):
- 4-week hosted API POC. Goals: prove streaming latency SLOs; validate tool-call reliability and timeout/retry behavior with their task API; collect metrics to model Dedicated cost.
- POC test cases: (1) simple chat -> stream response (2) search -> call create-task API (3) nested tool calls with timeout simulated (failure modes).
- Acceptance criteria: streaming first-token median < 300ms; tool-call success >= 95% under normal load; graceful fallback for tool-call timeout (clear UI state + human-in-loop flag).

CUSTOMER VOICE / QUOTES:
- "We need the assistant to feel instantaneous — streaming is non-negotiable." (CTO)
- "Tool calls failing silently will kill trust. We need obvious retry semantics and observability." (Lead PM)

PRICING / PROCUREMENT:
- Interested in Hosted to start; will evaluate Dedicated pricing once baseline metrics known. Early ask: ballpark Dedicated pilot cost for 3 months (estimate for 3 reserved GPUs). AE gave rough numbers; finance wants line-itemization for infra vs. platform.

TECH RISKS / BLOCKERS:
- Tool-call reliability/timeouts: primary technical risk. Need demo of idempotency and backoff patterns.
- Dedicated pricing and sizing: team wants model to show predictable unit economics vs hosted spend.
- Data residency confirmation for EU customers (some customers will require EU-only storage).

- Priya (SE): deliver test harness for tool-call timeout scenarios and sample tracing instrumentation (by 2026-03-16).
